title:
Welcome to the
factory floor.
lede: The progress page moves into a working bottling hall: labelled jars, moving water, pipes that always connect, and ten new features.

jars-night.png.title:
Every jar joined
to its pipe
jars-night.png.note: Actual local build of the website showing the public production totals on 25 October 2026. Not deployed yet.

jar-label.png.title:
A label on
every jar
jar-label.png.note: Actual local build, live totals. The zigzag band follows the painted walls of Kasena compounds; the dashed line marks the jar's next goal.

control-room.png.title: The control room
control-room.png.note: Actual local build. The delivery log lists real approvals from the public projection: collection, amount and time, never a name.

needs-help-trace.png.title:
Order the floor.
Trace a pipe.
needs-help-trace.png.note: Actual local build, live totals, ordered by Needs help, with the pointer on Oral Narrations.

day-shift.png.title: Day shift
day-shift.png.note: Actual local build, live totals. The lights follow your clock, or choose a shift yourself.

showcase.png.title:
Showcase mode
for a big screen
showcase.png.note: Actual local build, live totals: the tour shows one jar at a time, full screen.

sealed-sample.png.title:
Sealed when a
target is met
sealed-sample.png.note: Development preview with SAMPLE counts and targets (labelled on the page). No live collection has reached its target yet.

phone-control-room.png.title: On your phone
phone-control-room.png.note: Actual local build at phone width, live totals. Swipe the control room sideways.
